subject: Performance SLO follow-up & customer-led load test coordination - Finwise
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Gina Torres <gina.torres@finwise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T15:10:00Z
Subject: Performance SLO follow-up & customer-led load test coordination - Finwise

Hi Gina -- thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment before the customer-led load test: 

- Target SLOs you mentioned: p95 latency <= 300ms for non-streaming endpoints, sustained throughput ~200 req/s, concurrent sessions ~50, streaming support for long responses (chunked/Server-Sent Events).
- Test type: customer-led load test (you'll run k6 or Locust), Redwood will provide a test API key + test account and an allowed IP set. We'll also instrument tracing and have an on-call engineer watching.
- Scripts: please share the k6/Locust script you plan to run; we can validate locally and suggest header/auth patterns.
- Test window options: Tue Sep 2 09:00-11:00 PT or Wed Sep 3 14:00-16:00 PT. Please confirm preferred window and which endpoints (chat/generate/stream).

Action items for Finwise: confirm window, share test script and list of runner IPs (so we can pre-populate the allowlist).
Action items for Redwood: provide test credentials, IP allowlist, sample k6 config for streaming and a smoke-test checklist.

I attached a reference k6 script we typically start from and a short allowlist template. If you'd prefer Locust, we can provide that variant as well.

Thanks — looking forward to the run.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142
From: Gina Torres <gina.torres@finwise.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T15:38:00Z
Subject: Re: Performance SLO follow-up & customer-led load test coordination - Finwise

Thanks, Logan — that summary is perfect. We can run customer-led scripts. Preference: Tue Sep 2 09:00-11:00 PT works for our infra team. We'll focus on the /v1/generate (non-streaming) and /v1/stream endpoints.

I'll have our infra lead attach the k6 script and the list of NAT IPs used by our test runners. Expected load: 200 rps steady for 45 minutes, with a 15-minute cooldown; concurrency of ~50. We'll also include a small spike test (burst to 400 rps for 2 minutes).

Please send the test API key and allowlist by EOD Monday (2026-08-31) so we can run a quick smoke test. Also confirm the exact header format for streaming (we do chunked responses).

Gina
Gina Torres
Head of Platform Engineering, Finwise
gina.torres@finwise.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Gina Torres <gina.torres@finwise.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Performance SLO follow-up & customer-led load test coordination - Finwise

Hi Gina — thanks for confirming the window. Per Logan's note we've provisioned a short-lived test account and attached the credentials file. A few notes for the run: 

- Test endpoint: https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate (non-streaming) and https://api.redwood.inference/v1/stream (streaming).
- Test API key (attached in test-user-credentials.txt) is scoped to the Finwise-test project and will expire in 24 hours after the scheduled window.
- Allowlist: see allowlist_ips.txt (these are the IPs we need added). If your runner uses a dynamic pool, please provide CIDR ranges or the NAT gateway IPs.
- k6 notes: in our reference finwise_k6_script.js we include examples for both regular and streaming calls. For streaming, set the request to use chunked=true and process SSE frames; the script includes a helper to count streaming chunks and measure time-to-first-chunk.
- Payloads: please use representative prompt sizes (we recommended 256 tokens avg, with some longer 1k token scenarios to validate KV cache behavior).
- Monitoring & instrumentation: we'll produce per-second latency and token throughput metrics and post a live dashboard link to the shared Drive during the test.

Attachments included: finwise_k6_script.js, test-user-credentials.txt, allowlist_ips.txt.

Quick smoke test checklist (please confirm once done):
1) Deploy k6 script against /v1/generate at low RPS (5-10 rps) and confirm 200 OKs.
2) Verify streaming endpoint returns chunked frames and TTF first chunk < 200ms.
3) Confirm auth header: Authorization: Bearer <TEST_KEY>

If anything fails during the smoke, ping rishi on the shared Slack channel (link below). We'll have an infra engineer watching the run.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Gina Torres <gina.torres@finwise.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T16:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Performance SLO follow-up & customer-led load test coordination - Finwise

I'll be monitoring the run from our side. Slack: #finwise-loadtests (invite sent). If anything looks off, call the infra pager: +1 (650) 555-0199 (follow the voice prompt: Redwood Infra -> Loadtest).

- I'll watch autoscaling events and tail inference node logs; if we hit significant error rates we'll revert the routing policy to the fallback model variant.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Site Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Gina Torres <gina.torres@finwise.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Performance SLO follow-up & customer-led load test coordination - Finwise

Perfect — thanks everyone. We have the test window confirmed (Tue Sep 2 09:00-11:00 PT). We'll run the k6 script attached and run the smoke tests tomorrow. I'll post the runner IPs/ CIDRs and the final script by EOD Monday.

See you in the run.

Gina
